newsitem.title: USA: Mazel Stores to hold call on profit.
newsitem.headline: Mazel Stores to hold call on profit.

text.p: Mazel Stores Inc is to hold a telephone conference call with analysts at 1630 EDT/2030 GMT on Friday concerning its earnings expectations for the first quarter, according to Salomon Brothers analyst David Childe.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Shares plunged 6-5/8, or 34 percent, to 12-5/8 in mid-afternoon trade before the stock was halted by Nasdaq.
The company's first quarter ends in April, and Wall Street's mean estimate is $0.24 per share for the period, according to Zacks.
Childe declined to say whether he had spoken to company officials, saying "One can probably infer from the stock that they are not going to beat estimates."
The company, a regional closeout retailer and wholesaler, went public last November at $16.
